self_play_games_finished_0742_to_0757.method: collect_finished_games.sh kept the move logs of the self-play games that finished from 07:42 to 07:57 on 24 November (self-play-moves-update-595/), each copied at most 10 seconds before its end; self_play_finished.py replays them without searching and names each land battle's attacker, defender and zone from the state's battles

failed_games.failure: FailedMoveError: Cannot attack one's own possession
FailedMoveError: Battle opponents must differ except uncontested land or an explicit movement plan

held_out_evaluation.command: studies/campaign/runs/training-land-weighted-2026-11-22/evaluations/evaluate_newest_24_seeds.sh from 07:41 on 24 November for generation 595 on all 24 held-out seeds, with the Allies' and the Comintern's controls on the other 18; the other reports from evaluate.sh, axis_again.sh, evaluate_newest.sh and evaluate_more_seeds.sh on 23 November. The Axis games by watch_japan.py, the others by studies.campaign.run evaluate --target allies|comintern --baseline-style balanced --simulations 64 --max-depth 16 --max-transitions 10000 --neural-device cpu, from the run's code folder, each on one CPU core; the control adds --target-script balanced

wealth_at_game_end.source: each game's wealth_components_at_stop, means over the 24 games of each player of the alliance named first; the other two alliances scripted

japan_in_china.method: watch_japan.py plays the Axis games of each player with evaluate(track_japan=True) and logs the actions of Japan's turns, Dadao's among them. China's 13 land zones are those named land_china_.

memory_check.crash_rate: one in about 128 million network evaluations, the training run of 19 to 21 November
